text: I'm a huge fan of Raycon! My last set of Everyday Ear Buds lasted me 10 years before the batteries couldn't keep up anymore. I just received my new Fitness Ear Buds and they are fantastic. The price is so much better than every other brand, especially for the quality. The bass boost is perfect for me too, as I like to have a concert experience every time I put them in. I'm definitely a loyal Raycon customer & highly recommend them!
author: Christie W.

text: I had a pair of the Fitness Earbuds from several years ago that finally needed to be upgraded. I ordered a new pair and am delighted at the updated features. I am now able to connect between my cell and computer without having to disconnect each device. Still the same great sound quality, microphone, and fit! These are the only style of earbud that does not fall out of my ears!
author: Jessica K.
